verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is an agentic-commerce platform, so a merchant catalog feed for agent discovery is a fair question to ask. The evidence covers only card enrollment, tokenized credentials, purchase-intent mandates, Trusted Agent Protocol verification, and payment-link/invoice tools. Nothing documents a product feed or catalog import API that makes merchant inventory discoverable to agents.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can publish my product or service catalog into agent surfaces through a documented feed or import API so AI agents can discover what I sell
